title: Paros pirate and corsair bases, 1550-1700
question: Identify documented pirate and corsair bases, anchorages, safe harbours and repair stations on Paros, with original sources and precise locations.

discovery_leads.claim: Naoussa described as corsair anchorage and repair harbor, secondary account; consult its references.

Previous summary of Paros bases; not independent corroboration.
